name: Small Keypad
description: Interacting with the keypad will show a menu where the number can be entered. The stored numbers will be continuously output from the other output node. An on/off signal controls whether or not the keypad's backlight is enabled.
shortDescription: A keypad that allows a number to be input.

logicNodes.label: Backlight
logicNodes.description: Enables the backlight when receiving an on signal.
